name: anglické popisky (Format, Characters, WINDOW, Visual, Sound…), české repliky
text:
STORYBOARD – Cesta k moři
Format: 16:9, approximately 16 seconds.
Characters:
Martin: 40 years, short brown hair, sunglasses, white linen shirt, beige shorts
Lenka: 38 years, blonde ponytail, red sundress, straw hat
Props:
Car: old light-blue family car with a roof box
Map: large paper road map
Continuity: summer highway, bright sun, Lenka keeps the straw hat on the whole time

[WINDOW 1 | 0–4 s] Loading the car
Visual: Martin pushes the last suitcase into the full trunk.
Emotion: excited
Martin (triumphantly): „Všechno se vešlo! Můžeme vyrazit.“
Sound: trunk slam

[WINDOW 2 | 4–8 s] Navigation
Visual: In the car, Lenka unfolds the huge paper map, it covers half the windshield.
Emotion: comedic
Lenka (confused): „Kde přesně teď jsme? Tady je jenom Rakousko.“
Sound: rustling paper

[WINDOW 3 | 8–12 s] Phone
Visual: Martin calmly hands her his phone with navigation.
Emotion: amused
Martin (smiling): „Zkus radši tohle, lásko.“
Sound: navigation beep

[WINDOW 4 | 12–16 s] The sea
Visual: The car crests a hill and the blue sea appears.
Emotion: joy
Lenka (excited): „Moře! Vidím moře!“
Sound: seagulls, waves
On-screen text: „Dovolená začíná“
lines: Kde přesně teď jsme? Tady je jenom Rakousko.
